pair.invalid_credentials: SATS did not accept this member id/e-mail and password. Check them in the SATS app and try again.
pair.rate_limited: SATS is temporarily refusing logins (too many attempts). Wait a few minutes and try again.
pair.unreachable: Could not reach SATS. Check Homey's internet connection and try again.
pair.other_member: That login belongs to a different SATS member than this device. Add it as a new device instead.

device.session_expired: SATS session expired. Open the device, choose Repair and log in again.

errors.no_members: No SATS members are paired yet. Add a SATS member device first.
